headline.title: Voice AI in India is hard. Wispr Flow is betting on it anyway.
headline.summary: Wispr Flow reports accelerated growth in India following the launch of its Hinglish voice AI product, despite ongoing challenges in the voice AI sector. The company remains committed to expanding its offerings in the Indian market.

articles.title: So you’ve heard these AI terms and nodded along; let’s fix that
articles.summary: The article provides a glossary of key AI terms and phrases to help readers better understand the rapidly evolving language associated with artificial intelligence. It aims to clarify common jargon and improve comprehension of the field.

articles.title: Nvidia has already committed $40B to equity AI deals this year
articles.summary: Nvidia has invested $40 billion in equity deals related to artificial intelligence in 2023, reinforcing its position as a major player in the AI ecosystem. The company's significant financial commitment highlights its ongoing strategy to expand its influence in the AI sector.

articles.title: "OncoAgent: A Dual-Tier Multi-Agent Framework for Privacy-Preserving Oncology Clinical Decision Support"
articles.summary: Researchers have developed OncoAgent, a dual-tier multi-agent framework designed to enhance privacy in oncology clinical decision support systems. The framework aims to facilitate secure data sharing and improve decision-making processes while safeguarding patient confidentiality.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman week 2: OpenAI fires back, and Shivon Zilis reveals that Musk tried to poach Sam Altman
articles.summary: In the ongoing trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI, Musk has accused CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman of misleading him regarding his $38 million donation to the organization. Additionally, Shivon Zilis revealed that Musk attempted to recruit Altman away from OpenAI.

articles.title: Hackable Robot Lawn Mower Unlocks a New Nightmare
articles.summary: A newly discovered vulnerability in a robot lawn mower allows hackers to take control of the device, raising concerns about security in smart home technology. In related news, Meta has discontinued encrypted direct messaging on Instagram, and leaked documents reveal insights into Russia's training programs for elite hackers.

articles.title: Laid-off Oracle workers tried to negotiate better severance. Oracle said no.
articles.summary: Laid-off Oracle employees attempted to negotiate improved severance packages after discovering they were ineligible for WARN Act protections due to their classification as remote workers. Oracle declined their requests for better severance terms.
